braces.implementation: local bounded parser and recursive walker depths; no upstream patched release

sprintf-js.implementation: Local precision saturation to native bounds: 0..100 for e/f,1..100 for g; keeps valid outputs and avoids out-of-range worker termination; not an upstream release

zod.upstreamStatus: fixed in zod 4.6.6 for the v4 code only (v4 reference); the zod 3.25.76 copy under expo/@expo/cli has no upstream fix
zod.implementation: Local gate in the zod v3 code that @expo/cli loads (v3 has no upstream fix): ZodArray (exactLength, maxLength) and ZodSet (maxSize) return INVALID before parsing any element once the input is over its upper bound, after the existing size issues are recorded unchanged; min checks and in-bound behaviour are identical. Mirrors the intent of the 4.6.6 change (an upper size bound fails before any element is parsed); not an upstream release

deepmerge.upstreamStatus: open and unmerged; no patched release (affected >=4.2.0 <=4.3.1)
deepmerge.implementation: Local copy of the upstream PR 277 approach: a setProperty helper defines an own enumerable __proto__ key as a data property with Object.defineProperty (so the legacy __proto__ setter never changes the returned object prototype) and uses ordinary assignment for every other key; both mergeObject copy loops use it. No key is dropped, so every other merge result is unchanged; not an upstream release
